1x SW-0204-VW Video-Wall Processor

The SW-0204-VW 4x HDMI 2.0 Video Wall processor is an advanced 2x inputs (alternative) and 4x outputs video wall processor, providing video wall layout of 1x4 and 2x2 (rows x columns) with 4K and ultra-wide resolution support, independent analog audio output and image scaling. It also supports a user-friendly Web-UI, RS232 and Telnet for optimal flexibility control.

The SW-0204-VW supports 4-screen video walls with selectable modes, including 1x4 and 2x2 configurations. It extends the input video source across four displays, delivering stunning visual detail and an enhanced viewing experience. Advanced features, such as bezel correction, video wall flip, and flexible layout adjustments, allow precise customization for seamless multi-screen alignment.

Fully compatible with 4K@60Hz video content, the SW-0204-VW adheres to HDMI 2.0 and HDCP 2.3 standards. Its built-in scaling processor allows both upscaling and downscaling to resolutions up to 4K@60Hz 4:4:4, ensuring superior image quality and a fully immersive visual experience.

Supporting ultra-wide resolutions such as 3840x600, the SW-0204-VW is ideal for landscape-oriented video walls. This feature makes it a perfect choice for digital signage, conference rooms, and large-scale presentations.

The SW-0204-VW offers advanced audio functionality, including audio de-embedding from HDMI inputs and an audio mute option. These features provide clear, reliable audio output, complementing the visual performance of the video wall.

salesLanguage.headline: SW-0204-VW: turns multiple video signals or displays into a controlled visual layout
salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the customer needs more than basic switching, such as a video wall, multiview, scaling, source layout control or a more polished display presentation.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It helps create the visual result the customer actually wants on screen, rather than simply moving a signal from source to display.
salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Video walls, monitoring screens, hospitality displays, retail feature walls, education spaces and room systems that need layout or scaling control.
salesLanguage.salespersonCue: Ask what the screens should look like in use: one big image, several sources, fixed presets, flexible layouts or simple source switching.
talkTrack: It is about shaping the final display layout, not only routing a source.
It can be the cleaner answer when the requirement is a fixed visual wall or display-processing task rather than scalable building-wide AV.
Check whether the customer needs a dedicated processor, matrix processing, or AV-over-IP video wall behaviour.
